Star Wars CCG is a two-player customizable card game. You drain Force at locations you control, battle with characters and starships, and reduce the opponent’s Life Force to zero.

Start with [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]] (how to play). The comprehensive Decipher rulings are [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]] plus the [[Decipher Glossary Supplement]]. PDF library: [[Rulebooks]]. Current Players Committee play: [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (not Decipher).

Play in a browser: [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]
